business_definition: Cancelled orders divided by all orders.
caveat: Operational context and possible promotion side effect; not a direct support outcome.

business_definition: Chargeback disputes tied to an order cohort for every 1,000 orders.
caveat: Late-posting; use maturity views before declaring recent cohorts stable.
decision_threshold: No more than 10% relative increase versus mature holdout

business_definition: Orders delivered after the promised duration divided by delivered orders.
caveat: Source-system duration units are standardized in staging.

business_definition: Scenario-only loyalty risk based on synthetic assumptions.
caveat: Simulated, not observed. Never present as measured company performance.

business_definition: Attributed support contacts for every 1,000 orders.
caveat: A decline can indicate either better service or suppressed access.

business_definition: Channel-specific contact handling cost divided by all orders.
numerator: AI, phone, and email handling cost
caveat: Visible support cost only; not a standalone success metric.
Does not capture customers who never initiated a contact.

business_definition: Mean optional 1-5 satisfaction score among respondents.
caveat: Not representative without response-rate and respondent-mix checks.

display_name: Observed 28-day reorder rate after an issue
business_definition: Issue episodes followed by another order within 28 days among mature, observable episodes.
numerator: Eligible episodes with a subsequent order in 28 days
denominator: Issue episodes with a full 28-day observation window
caveat: Late cohorts are right-censored and excluded.
decision_threshold: No more than 2 percentage point degradation versus holdout

business_definition: Contacted orders with more than one attributed contact.
Contacts with a resolved end state and no repeat contact for the same order within seven days.
caveat: Seven days is a declared analysis window, not a source-system field.
decision_threshold: No more than 3 percentage point degradation versus holdout

display_name: Fully loaded failure cost per order
business_definition: Handling, refunds, credits, chargeback disputes, and processor fees divided by all orders.
caveat: Finance entries are attributed to order cohort and require maturity.

business_definition: Order contribution margin less handling, refund, credit, chargeback dispute, and chargeback fee costs.
caveat: Does not monetize unobserved lifetime-value loss.
decision_threshold: Positive treatment effect after finance maturity

business_definition: Contacts flagged resolved by the CRM.
caveat: Optimistic for AI exits; compare with verified resolution.

business_definition: Share of contacts with a valid CSAT response.
